title: FedSubMuon: Communication-Efficient Federated LLM Fine-Tuning via Structured Subspace Muon
abstract: arXiv:2609.06073v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated fine-tuning adapts large language models (LLMs) to decentralized client data, but its scalability in cross-device training is often limited by the high communication cost. Muon is an optimizer that improves optimization performance by orthogonalizing momentum for matrix-valued parameters. Existing federated Muon methods demonstrate the benefit of matrix-aware optimization in federated learning, but still require transmitting full layer-size updates and optimizer state. A natural way to reduce communication is to directly apply Muon to LoRA factors, but this changes the optimized object and weakens Muon's matrix-aware update geometry. We propose FedSubMuon, a communication-efficient federated Muon fine-tuning method that optimizes compact coefficient matrices within shared structured subspaces. This design keeps Muon on a single matrix-valued trainable object, while reducing the client upload to compact coefficient matrices. W

translated_title: FedSubMuon：基于结构化子空间Muon的通信高效联邦大语言模型微调
translated_abstract: 联邦微调使大语言模型（LLM）能够适应分散的客户端数据，但其在跨设备训练中的可扩展性往往受到高昂通信成本的限制。Muon是一种通过对矩阵值参数的动量进行正交化来提升优化性能的优化器。现有的联邦Muon方法证明了矩阵感知优化在联邦学习中的优势，但仍需传输完整层大小的更新和优化器状态。减少通信的一种自然方式是直接将Muon应用于LoRA因子，但这会改变被优化的对象并削弱Muon的矩阵感知更新几何特性。我们提出FedSubMuon，一种通信高效的联邦Muon微调方法，它在共享的结构化子空间内优化紧凑的系数矩阵。这一设计使Muon保持在单一的矩阵值可训练对象上，同时将客户端上传量减少为紧凑的系数矩阵。
tldr: FedSubMuon通过在共享结构化子空间中优化紧凑系数矩阵，在保持Muon矩阵感知优化特性的同时，将客户端上传量从完整层大小的更新压缩为紧凑系数矩阵，从而大幅降低联邦LLM微调的通信成本。
en_tdlr: FedSubMuon achieves communication-efficient federated LLM fine-tuning by optimizing compact coefficient matrices within shared structured subspaces, preserving Muon's matrix-aware update geometry while reducing client uploads from full layer-size updates to compact coefficient matrices.
